test_series_diff_requires_integer: test that Series.diff() raises ValueError when periods is not an integer
test_diff_np: test that np.diff on a Series returns a numpy array of consecutive differences
test_diff_int: test that Series.diff() correctly computes differences for large integer values
test_diff_tz: test that Series.diff() works with datetime index and supports negative and zero periods
test_diff_dt64: test that Series.diff() computes timedelta differences for datetime64 Series
